title: fix(showcase): the invoice print page heads its line-items table with labels, not field names
body:
Fixes #23985
Clause-②: no. An example app's column headings change. No export, type or accept set moves.

## What

The invoice print page (`showcase_invoice_document`) heads its line-items table with labels now, not raw field names. This is the card's acceptance option 1, **Showcase**. No contract changed.

- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/invoice-document.page.ts`: the four `record:line_items` columns each declare a `label`, taken from the invoice line field's own label in `invoice.object.ts`:

  | column | was headed | now headed |
  |:---|:---|:---|
  | `description` | `description` | `Description` |
  | `quantity` | `quantity` | `Qty` |
  | `unit_price` | `unit_price` | `Unit Price` |
  | `amount` | `amount` | `Amount` |

  `Qty` is the field's own label, and it is also the header the master-detail grid hydrates for the same field. A short comment above the array says why the labels are declared here.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/invoice-document-line-items.test.ts` (new): the pin.

## Why the page, not the renderer

`RecordLineItemsProps.columns` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) reads: "Unlike the master-detail carriers, this block does NOT hydrate a column from the child object's field: declare `label`, `type` and `options` yourself — an identity-only `{ name }` column is a text cell headed by its name." The renderer does what that says. At the pin `f8267df93a`, objectui's `LineItemsPanel` passes `schema.columns` through `applyColumnPermissions` only, and `GridField` heads each column with `c.label || c.name`. The page was the off-contract part, so the page is what changed.

## Can the zh-CN print translate these headings? No.

On a zh-CN print the four headings read in English: `Description`, `Qty`, `Unit Price`, `Amount`. Before this PR they read as raw field names, which are also English. Measured on `origin/main` `c1c0a90942`:

- **No inline locale map.** A column's `label` is `InlineGridColumnSchema.label`, which is `z.string().optional()` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`). It does not take the `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` map that `I18nLabelSchema` takes.
- **No bundle key.** The page's other headings are translated by name. The two `record:details` sections go through `objects.showcase_invoice._sections.invoice` / `.amounts`, and the page label through `pages.showcase_invoice_document.label`. A page component's copy goes through `pages.NAME.components.ID.KEY`. `translatePage` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) overlays only `PAGE_COMPONENT_COPY_KEYS` (`title`, `description`, `label`, `placeholder`, `emptyText`) onto `properties.KEY`. No key reaches `properties.columns[i].label`, and the extractor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) does not walk `columns` either.

So the labels are literal English, as the dispatch directs when neither route exists. No translation mechanism was added. The translation bundle is untouched.

The zh-CN sheet is therefore mixed: translated section headings (发票, 金额), bilingual header and footer text, and English column headings. Closing that gap takes a contract change, which is the card's option 2. That is spec-lane work and is not built here; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

All runs are on head `0de6f72ee4`. `origin/main` is still `c1c0a90942`, so the pre-PR merge was a no-op.

- New pin, alone: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/invoice-document-line-items.test.ts` gave `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- Full showcase suite: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` gave `Test Files 35 passed (35)`, `Tests 427 passed (427)`.
- Showcase typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exited 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test file (count 1).
- Dependency closure built first: `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/example-showcase^...' --concurrency=2`, 62 of 62 tasks successful.

The pin's three cases:
1. The page carries exactly one `record:line_items` block. Its child object is `showcase_invoice_line`, and its columns are `description`, `quantity`, `unit_price`, `amount`.
2. Each column's `label` equals its child field's own `label`, and never equals the field name. The expected value comes from `InvoiceLine.fields` rather than a hard-coded string, so the print stays in step with the field definitions.
3. The block passes a full `RecordLineItemsProps.safeParse`, and the parsed output equals the authored properties, so `label` is an accepted key and is not stripped.

**Ablation**, one leg, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on the committed fix. The four-line `columns` array was put back to today's single line of identity-only columns:

- Landed: anchor hits 1 → 0, and the blob went `1e5578e84b55` → `c9acb7dcda24`.
- Result: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. Case 2 failed with `AssertionError: column 'description' must declare its heading: expected undefined to be 'Description'`.
- Restored: the blob after restore equals the blob at HEAD (`1e5578e84b55`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty. This was re-checked independently with `git hash-object` against `HEAD:` and a clean `git status --porcelain`.

The direction was red, as expected. The page is imported from source by a relative path, so no `dist/` sat between the mutation and the test.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 42 commands from this change set, on the tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0de6f72ee4`. All 42 were run, and each exit was recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reconciled them: "42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

- 42 of 42 exit 0 in their final reading.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 on its first run, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It reads every package's `dist/`, and nine packages outside the showcase closure were not built yet. That is not a measurement. `check:type-check-debt`, later in the same sequence, builds every package itself. The real command was then rerun and exited 0: "111 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load".
- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` reports `OK (14 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. That confirms the literal column labels add no keys to the ratchet.
- `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` first swept only the 62 built packages. After the full build they were rerun and exited 0 again, sweeping 75 and 72 packages.

CI families are left to this PR's check-runs.

## No changeset

`@objectstack/example-showcase` is `"private": true` and publishes nothing, so this PR carries the `skip-changeset` label. `Check Changeset` reads that label live; it does not read this body.

## Acceptance notes

- **Contract option, not built.** Option 2 of the card is the only route to translated zh-CN line-items headings. Under it, `record:line_items` would hydrate an identity-only column from the child field the way the master-detail carriers do, and an objectui renderer change would follow. It is spec-lane work and out of this card's scope (triage `6221505080`). Nothing was filed. The report puts it to the seat as an open question.
- **Static reading, not measured on a render.** In the read-only branch of `GridField` at the pin, a cell that is not `lookup`, `file` or temporal prints `String(value)`. So `unit_price` and `amount` print as bare numbers. Declaring `type: 'currency'` would right-align them but would not format them. These columns declare no `type`, so they are also left-aligned. This is noted only. It was not reproduced, and no card was filed. Carrier: none.
- **No browser render on this head.** The original failure was measured on the real PDF, in Chromium, by the card ③ dev of #22269 (comment `6208035645`). This PR changes only declared metadata that the renderer draws verbatim, and the pin holds that metadata.
